messages:
Sam K: Heads up — RFI from Vanguardia (large fintech). They sent a capability spreadsheet and a security questionnaire. Need to confirm capability matrix answers, POC runbook, and pricing clarifications. Drive links in the thread. Can solutions eng + legal own the security questionnaire and HSM/KMS clarifications?

Lia P: Thanks Sam. Quick Q: what's their expected QPS and target latency for the POC? that'll drive Dedicated vs Hosted rec.

Jordan M: Just heard back from their architect — target ~150 TPS peak, embedding-heavy traffic, p90 latency 100ms. They want EU data residency for prod.

Tyler G: For 150 TPS embeddings I'd recommend Dedicated with autoscale burst (2x baseline). Suggest H100 class with INT8 quantization. Also propose hybrid dev flow: Hosted for sandbox + Dedicated for prod. Need avg token counts.

Sam K: Sequence length ~512 typical, avg tokens per request ~120. Also they require customer-managed keys / HSM for production.

Mel R: Legal note: customer-managed KMS/HSM is supported on Private deployments; we need to scope VPC peering and add a support addendum. I'll flag required contract language for DPA and KMS SLA.

Jordan M: I'll start drafting capability matrix answers. Question for TYler: which models are certified for Private + HSM and quant-aware? Need exact model names for the RFI table.

Tyler G: Certified models we can list: rdx-base-1.0, rdx-llm-3.2, open-gpt-large (quant-aware). Pasteable snippet: ```Models certified for Private/HSM: rdx-base-1.0, rdx-llm-3.2, open-gpt-large (INT8/Q4). Notes: latency profiles attached in perf report.```

Lia P: Pricing ask: they want committed monthly capacity with burst credits. What's our standard committed tier for Dedicated (and is a short-term PoC discount allowed)?

Sam K: We can propose a 3-month PoC commit. Recommend Silver (4 GPUs) or Gold (8 GPUs) tiers. For commercial, offer 20% off committed monthly rate + 2-week burst credits for the POC. Lia — can you confirm commercial okay to proceed with that table?

Mel R: Please include copies of SOC2 & ISO27001 certs and our standard DPA. Legal will add tracked-changes for HSM clause X.

Jordan M: I'll upload the filled capability matrix CSV and start the security questionnaire answers. Anyone have a clean HSM wording snippet we reuse?

Tyler G: Use the internal doc "HSM-KMS-phrasing-v2" — it has the exact line items legal prefers. Link: https://drive.redwood/hsm-kms-v2.docx

sales-bot: Reminder: RFI deadline in 48h. Checklist: capability matrix (CSV), security questionnaire (completed), pricing sheet, SOW draft, attachments (certs/DPA).

Sam K: :thumbsup: I'll consolidate everything and send the draft response to Vanguardia by EOD tomorrow. Jordan — can you own the security questionnaire? Lia — confirm discount by noon so I can lock pricing in the RFI.

Lia P: On it. I'll loop in Commercial and reply with confirmed numbers by 12:00.

Mel R: Legal will produce DPA edits and SOC/ISO attachments. Expect tracked changes by 18:00.

Jordan M: On security questionnaire — starting now. Expect draft answers in ~12h. Uploaded current matrix: https://drive.redwood/vanguardia-cap-matrix.csv

Tyler G: I'll put a POC runbook (ops steps, monitoring checklist, rollback plan) into Drive under /pocs/vanguardia. Will include expected SLOs and load test scripts. :rocket:
